aci_feedback: only predictions previously emitted in this fold, whose delivery day <= D-2 and whose entire delivery day has observed prices; no calibration replay or embargo feedback
aci_grid_rationale: At most 2161 evaluation hours in a 90-day fold, so largest step moves any coverage state by at most 0.04322. Even all misses keep c95 <= 0.991059, below n_cal/(n_cal+1) for these 60-day slices. All-hit paths stay above zero. This conservative grid avoids infinite quantiles without clipping the ratified update. It limits adaptation speed and no long-run ACI guarantee is claimed for the delayed finite experiment.
aci_reference_scores: fixed initial calibration slice, unscaled; one-based ceil((n_cal+1)*c); no clipping, interpolation, or rolling residual buffer
aci_state: coverage level c = 1 - paper miscoverage alpha; initialize each pair at nominal coverage
aci_update: c += gamma * (nominal_coverage - inclusive_hit); process each released hourly observation once in stored chronological order, before predicting a whole delivery day
c3_rejection: Not implemented: regime taxonomy would encode dates chosen after inspecting price history; §4.3 pre-run rejection.
evidence_class: development_calibration_comparison; no holdout evaluation, no artifact freeze
falsification: selected candidate full fold_3 evaluation coverage95 >= 0.394; also report the preserved August peak window and v1 on both windows so the 0.194 subwindow baseline is not presented as a full-fold baseline
isotonic: last, existing PAVA, feedback uses final emitted intervals
reference: v1 unscaled CQR, reported but outside the §4.3 candidate set
selection_scalar: sum of pinball losses / (9 * eligible observations), after isotonic; exact ties use candidate_order
spread: max(raw_p95 - raw_p05, 1 EUR/MWh); no pre-sorting of raw heads
volatility_boundary: 168 canonical UTC hours strictly before delivery-day local midnight, same legal D-1 price boundary as v1
